name: Pipeliners - GBP Posts Week of 2026-08-17
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-08-14

# Summary
A Word doc of daily Google Business Profile post proposals for Monday Aug 17 to Friday Aug 21, 2026, each with a photo from `Pipeliners Photos\`, a short caption and a longer commercial-intent caption. Proposal only; nothing was posted (GBP is read-only for Claude).

# Topics
- Mon: sewer camera inspection and drain diagnosis.
- Tue: root intrusion in the sewer line.
- Wed: everyday plumbing repairs (under-sink work).
- Thu: commercial trenchless pipe lining.
- Fri: trenchless CIPP sewer lining.

# Issues against current rules
- Every caption uses the phone number 480-269-1874, which the Oct 1 handoff lists as an old or unknown number. Never hardcode numbers in new content.
- Wednesday mentions water heaters, repipes and general fixture work, which Pipeliners does not offer.
- Thursday promises commercial work (scope unconfirmed by Scott) and uses "pipe lining" as a noun.
- Do not reuse this copy as is.
